basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar) has officially announced the JRF/Project Associate-I, PostDoc/Research Associate-III, and Project Assistant/Field Assistant/Field Worker Recruitment 2026 with 9 openings. The detailed notification is available on the official website, https://www.iitrpr.ac.in/. Candidates possessing B.Tech./B.E., M.Sc., M.Tech./M.E./M.S., Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS, or a Graduate degree in the relevant disciplines as prescribed in the notification are eligible to apply online. qualification.education_qualification: B.Tech/ B.E./ MSc or M.Tech./M.E./M.S, PhD/ MD/ MS/ MDS or equivalent or 3 years research/teaching/design experience after ME/ M.Tech, Graduate degree in any discipline
qualification.details: JRF / Project Associate-I: B.Tech/B.E./MSc or M.Tech./M.E./M.S. in Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Communication Engineering/ Computer science/or similar field or equivalent qualification with 60% marks (or 6 grade points out of 10). Applicants should have a valid GATE score or pass other National Eligibility Tests or National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Institutions. Applicants without GATE may be considered with lower Emoluments as per the Institute rules. PostDoc / Research Associate III: PhD/MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree or having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after ME/M.Tech with at least one research paper in Science Citation indexed (SCI) Journal. Note: PhD thesis submitted candidates can also apply. Project Assistant / Field Assistant / Field worker: Graduate degree in any discipline.

content_sections.text: JRF / Project Associate-I: B.Tech/B.E./MSc or M.Tech./M.E./M.S. in Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Communication Engineering/ Computer science/or similar field or equivalent qualification with 60% marks (or 6 grade points out of 10). Applicants without GATE may be considered with lower Emoluments as per the Institute rules. Note: PhD thesis submitted candidates can also apply. Project Assistant / Field Assistant / Field worker: Graduate degree in any discipline.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Ropar Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-07-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Ropar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026 is 31st July 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 9 vacancies are available for the posts of JRF / Project Associate-I, PostDoc / Research Associate III, and Project Assistant / Field Assistant / Field worker.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the JRF / Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech/B.E./MSc or M.Tech./M.E./M.S. in relevant fields with 60% marks and a valid GATE score or equivalent national eligibility test.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant / Field Assistant / Field worker post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Assistant / Field Assistant / Field worker post is Rs. 24000 + 9% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit for the recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits for the posts. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any specific age criteria.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an Application Review. Further details might be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates with a submitted PhD thesis apply for the PostDoc / Research Associate III position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have submitted their PhD thesis can also apply for the PostDoc / Research Associate III position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is contractual, as per the information provided.
